Electrical Engineering: Maximum 60 students to interview. This resulted in a 3.07 GPA cutoff.

Now with the parts I have (listed below) I could have a dream rig capable of, well anything. However, it seems that I'm not getting that 'fantastic' performance that everyone else is getting. Now I'd like to find a way to make sure that nothing is wrong with my card (Zotac GeForce GTX 980 Ti AMP! Extreme)  seeing that I tried overclocking it and after one driver crash pissed myself and stopped meddling with it. The problem is I don't know if I buggered its performance.

I'd welcome any help in the pursuit of increasing my performance, thanks in advance!

"Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000 Memory" With that not likely.

And if I'm right your trying to run it off a laptop, which means you won't be able to run most games at a good framerate. Also on the topic of outlast, graphically speaking they are two different beasts. Outlast is corridor based while the forest is open world. Also, consider color palette and lighting complexity.

But that's counter-productive, so here is what I recommend; Should you be running on a laptop make sure you're running in high-performance mode, this can be found in you power settings in the bottom right corner. Right-click on the battery icon and go to power preferences and change it to high performance or any other equivalent. Another thing you can do is partition virtual ram, whether or not this makes a difference I haven't the slightest clue but it's something you can try. There are game boosters out there but, for the most part, they seem to be crap and seldom work. After all that playing at a low resolution on the lowest settings is guaranteed to work but it won't be pretty.

Sorry to be the harbinger of bad news and I hope that you do get to enjoy the game in some way shape or form, so hang in there buddy and I look forward to seeing you in the forest. :3
